claims.text: In the prelude of the siege of Minas Tirith on 9 March , Gondorian lords of the Outlands arrived with their troops at Minas Tirith to aid in the defence of the City. Dervorin came to Minas Tirith on foot, leading three hundred men.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age", entry for the year 3019, March 9, p. 1093; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "Minas Tirith", p. 770

claims.text: The actions of Dervorin during the siege of Minas Tirith and the Battle of the Pelennor Fields are not mentioned. His name was not mentioned in the list of lords and sons of lords of Gondor, of Rohan or of the Rangers of the North who died in the Battle of the Pelennor Fields. In addition, it is not mentioned if Dervorin went with the Army of the West to the Black Gate of Mordor and particpated in the Battle of the Morannon and if he survived the War of the Ring and returned to the Ringló Vale.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Battle of the Pelennor Fields", p. 849
